mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates an ongoing monetary tightening cycle that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS has been rising for at least 3 consecutive months, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year change in CPI (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 5.0%, it signals persistent inflation that triggers aggressive monetary policy responses, causing a sell-off in equities and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY > 5.0%, or the Rank IC for the signal is below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) and an increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates a tightening labor market that fuels wage growth and inflation, prompting the Federal Reserve to accelerate rate hikes, which depresses equity valuations and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE falls and PAYEMS rises simultaneously, or the Rank IC for the joint signal is below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During a housing market downturn (HOUST below 1700 thousand units), consumer spending on durable goods contracts, reducing corporate revenue growth expectations and leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when HOUST < 1700, or the Rank IC for the signal is below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in retail sales (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer spending, which boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when RSAFS is rising, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 100 (index base 2017=100), it signals a contraction in manufacturing output, reducing corporate profits and leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO < 100, or the Rank IC for the signal is below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent decline in quarterly GDP (GDPC1) and monthly retail sales (RSAFS) signals a deteriorating economic outlook, causing a sell-off in equities and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both GDPC1 and RSAFS decline, or the Rank IC for the joint signal is below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) exceeds 1.0%, it signals a restrictive monetary policy stance that increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate investment, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 1.0%, or the Rank IC for the signal is below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.
